purpose: Incrementally reconcile the frozen B01 feature inventory into L1-L8 contract traceability without creating new capabilities or silently changing existing contracts.

governance.rule: Existing contracts are reused; gaps are marked MISSING/PARTIAL/CONFLICT and require reconciliation or Change Control before GREEN.

greenRule: Every B01 feature must have complete bidirectional traceability across page, API, DTO, data, security, entitlement, state, event, worker, D1, tests and evidence. Missing or conflicting authoritative mappings keep B01 NOT_GREEN.

records.name: registration

hierarchy.l6: Create account from an accepted registration request
hierarchy.l7: Must create exactly one authoritative account outcome per accepted idempotent request and enter the existing account lifecycle
hierarchy.l8: Feature contract mapped to existing authRegister operation and account state machine

records.d1Domain: UNRESOLVED: frozen 4-domain mapping must be reconciled; legacy account contract names D1-01

hierarchy.l6: Authenticate credentials and revoke the current session
hierarchy.l7: Authentication must evaluate account state and session policy; logout must be idempotent and revocation-authoritative
hierarchy.l8: Feature contract mapped to existing authLogin/authLogout operations

records.name: username/email/phone credentials

hierarchy.l6: Normalize, validate and associate an accepted identifier with an identity
hierarchy.l7: Normalization and uniqueness must be deterministic and must not disclose protected account existence
hierarchy.l8: Existing identity registry coverage; detailed data/security mapping remains open

blockers: canonical API IDs not established in current inventory

hierarchy.l6: Validate authorized password lifecycle request and rotate credential state
hierarchy.l7: Recovery tokens are single-use and time-bounded; credential material is never exposed
hierarchy.l8: Existing identity registry coverage; API/DTO/security evidence incomplete

records.name: email/phone verification

hierarchy.l6: Consume a valid verification challenge and update the existing account lifecycle
hierarchy.l7: Verification token must be single-use, time-bounded and bound to its intended identity and purpose
hierarchy.l8: Existing registry and account-state references; complete API/event/evidence mapping open

blockers: verification API and event IDs missing

hierarchy.l6: Register and authenticate a bound passkey under the existing identity security model
hierarchy.l7: Credential binding, origin, replay and account-state checks are mandatory
hierarchy.l8: Blueprint capability exists; detailed canonical contracts are not yet established

hierarchy.l6: Enroll, challenge and verify a configured factor
hierarchy.l7: Factor enrollment and recovery must be scoped to the authenticated identity and protected against replay
hierarchy.l8: Blueprint capability exists; detailed canonical contracts are not yet established

records.name: OAuth/social login

hierarchy.l5: Sign in with an external identity provider
hierarchy.l6: Validate provider identity and safely associate or authenticate the local identity
hierarchy.l7: Provider assertions require verification, anti-account-takeover checks and deterministic linking policy
hierarchy.l8: Existing blueprint capability; provider/API/data contracts remain to be reconciled

blockers: provider integration and linked-identity contract mapping missing

hierarchy.l6: Add, verify, inspect and unlink an external identity within policy
hierarchy.l7: Unlinking cannot strand an account or remove its final viable recovery path without an explicit safety rule
hierarchy.l8: Blueprint capability exists; detailed identity-link contract remains open

hierarchy.l6: List owned sessions/devices and revoke a selected session
hierarchy.l7: Scope is self-only unless a separately authorized administrative flow exists; revocation is authoritative and idempotent
hierarchy.l8: Mapped to existing authSessionList/authSessionRevoke and identity registry

hierarchy.l6: Issue, rotate, revoke and reject invalid or reused session credentials
hierarchy.l7: Rotation and revocation must dominate stale credentials; replay and reuse must be detectable
hierarchy.l8: Refresh operation exists in auth policy but remains contract-partial

records.name: suspicious-login detection

hierarchy.l6: Evaluate authentication risk and require the applicable challenge or denial
hierarchy.l7: Risk is a signal, not a final enforcement authority; decisions must remain auditable and policy-bound
hierarchy.l8: Referenced by existing auth login anti-abuse policy; detailed risk contract remains open

blockers: risk signal/event/decision contracts and security evidence incomplete

records.name: account freeze/suspension/ban

hierarchy.l7: Only valid state-machine transitions are allowed; protected mutations and sessions must respect enforced states
hierarchy.l8: Mapped to existing authoritative account state machine

blockers: existing-user account_state/account_state_version backfill policy remains an explicit decision gate
D1-01 migration execution and post-schema evidence remain pending
security/lifecycle, runtime and Evidence Registry mapping remain incomplete

records.name: account recovery

hierarchy.l6: Validate a time-bounded recovery challenge and restore permitted access
hierarchy.l7: Recovery must be single-use, time-bounded, identity-bound and must not bypass account enforcement policy
hierarchy.l8: Existing identity registry coverage; complete API/DTO/security mapping open

blockers: canonical recovery API/DTO and security evidence missing

hierarchy.l5: Request, cancel or restore account lifecycle
hierarchy.l6: Execute only valid deletion/restoration state transitions
hierarchy.l7: Deletion is state-machine controlled; legal hold and retention rules override normal deletion; direct resurrection is forbidden
hierarchy.l8: Mapped to existing account state machine and identity registry

hierarchy.l5: Submit and use a verified identity attribute
hierarchy.l6: Verify an identity attribute under its applicable policy and expose only authorized verification state
hierarchy.l7: Verification status cannot itself grant unrelated permissions; role, permission and entitlement remain separate authorities
hierarchy.l8: Blueprint capability exists; cross-domain verification contracts must be reconciled with B03 and B13/B20

crossCuttingConflicts.description: Legacy D1-01 vs frozen D01 Core logical-domain naming conflict resolved by Change Control; D01 Core is canonical for AUTH-006/AUTH-013/AUTH-015 affected reconciliation surfaces.
crossCuttingConflicts.requiredAction: None — resolved by CC-MAPPING-0-D1-DOMAIN-NAMING-CONFLICT-2026-09-19; physical D1 schema or deployment must not be inferred.

crossCuttingConflicts.description: Legacy/alternative Worker ownership references are superseded for current ownership by the ACTIVE/CANONICAL 12-Worker Master and canonical Worker × D1 Binding Mapping.
crossCuttingConflicts.requiredAction: None — current Worker authority and binding are reconciled. Future ownership changes require an explicit approved Mapping/Contract change.
crossCuttingConflicts.resolution: W01 = Public API / Gateway / Developer & Admin API Boundary; W02 = Identity / Account / Authorization; W01 has no direct authoritative D1 authority; W02 owns D1-01 identity/account/authorization.

crossCuttingConflicts.description: The apparent /auth/* versus /v1/* conflict is a representation-layer difference: OpenAPI declares server base /api/v1 and operation-relative paths such as /auth/*; the API alignment inventory canonicalizes those paths to /v1/* while retaining openapiPath separately.
crossCuttingConflicts.requiredAction: Reconciliation verified by existing API contract CI/alignment normalization rules; do not duplicate the server base in operation paths.
